newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-No impact from BHP decision - Simsmetal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-No impact from BHP decision - Simsmetal.

text.p: Metals recycler Simsmetal Ltd said on Friday that any closure of the Broken Hill Pty Co Pty Ltd's Newcastle steel plant would not affect Simsmetals operations.
"I don't think it will be a concern at all," Simsmetal managing director John Crabb told the group's annual meeting.
Crabb said Simsmetal supplies most of its products to BHP's Sydney mini-mill and its Port Kembla plant, south of Sydney.
"Maybe it will make life easier for us because we will be able to buy more scrap," Crabb said, responding to a shareholders question.

BHP said in September it was looking at all options for its steel facilities after writing off the value of the primary steel making facilities at its Newcastle works because of deteriorating cash flow projections from those assets.
At 12.05 p.m. (0105 GMT), Simsmetal shares were steady at A$6.88 on turnover of 30,090 shares.
